card.name: End of a quantity before a time span
card.fires_on: The closing parenthesis after a total amount in a dose limit, or the unit word just before a per-period phrase such as 'in 24 hours' or 'per month'.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis of max total

card.writes: It seems to suppress words meaning 'today' or 'this week' in Chinese and English, so the next word is a time period phrase rather than a time-marker.
